title: Ideal membership in a localization clears a denominator
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $\mathfrak p\subset A$ a prime ideal [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Write $S=A\setminus\mathfrak p$ and $A_{\mathfrak p}=S^{-1}A$ using [def-weil-pbc-module-localization]. For an ideal $I\subseteq A$ and $a\in A$, the image $a/1$ belongs to the ideal of $A_{\mathfrak p}$ generated by the images of $I$ if and only if there exists $s\in S$ with $s a\in I$.
